ideas.raw: programable dynamic knob with haptic feedback
ideas.objective: A single rotary knob hardware device that reads its own rotation precisely and uses motorized/magnetic resistance to simulate different configurable feel profiles (detents, end-stops, free spin) depending on which application or mode it's programmed for.
ideas.assumption: Read as a physical rotary knob device (magnetic encoder + motor/brake) that can be reprogrammed per-application to simulate different detents and resistance, not a software-only UI knob.

ideas.objective: A mobile app that lets a single user create, edit, complete and organize personal to-do tasks, with data persisted across sessions.
ideas.assumption: Read as a basic personal to-do list mobile app (single user, iOS) with task entry, editing and local persistence, no collaboration or sync features specified.

ideas.raw: screw dispenser and counter linked with a online database of all the parts that i have
ideas.objective: A device that dispenses screws one at a time, counts how many were dispensed, and updates an online inventory database of parts on hand.
ideas.assumption: Read as a mechanical hopper that singulates and dispenses screws one at a time, counts them via sensor, and syncs inventory counts to a cloud-hosted parts database with an API, rather than just a manual counting app.

ideas.clarifying_question: What do you want to animate — a character, an object, a short scene?

ideas.clarification: a smart coaster that senses the weight of the drink on it
ideas.objective: A coaster that weighs the drink placed on it and indicates something (e.g. presence, remaining amount) using an embedded load sensor and electronics.
ideas.assumption: Read as a load-sensing coaster that detects drink presence/weight via a built-in scale, not a PCB art piece; assumed to show status via LEDs rather than a screen.

ideas.raw: blender animation dish looking out a fishtank in Chinese restaurant
ideas.objective: A short Blender animation depicting a fish inside a restaurant fishtank watching the Chinese restaurant scene outside the glass.
ideas.assumption: Read as a short stylized 3D animation: a fish (the "dish" fish/pet) in a tank looking out at a Chinese restaurant interior, not a literal food dish; focus is a single character shot with environment, not a full narrative short.

ideas.raw: 3d printed iPhone mount for golf bag to record my golf swings
ideas.objective: A 3D-printed mount that clamps onto a golf bag and holds an iPhone steady at a useful angle to record golf swings.
ideas.assumption: Read as a clamp that mounts to a golf bag strap/frame tube and holds an iPhone at an angle to film swings, not a motorized tracking mount.

ideas.raw: 3d printed color matching type pokemon bulk storage
ideas.objective: A set of 3D printed modular bins/dividers that let someone store and organize bulk Pokemon cards separated by energy type, identifiable by color coding.
ideas.assumption: Read as a modular stackable storage system for bulk Pokemon cards, with bins or dividers color-coded/labeled by card type (fire, water, grass, etc.), not an automated sorting machine.

ideas.objective: A 3D-printed gridfinity-compatible organizer with tool-shaped cutouts sized to hold a specific set of hand tools in a drawer.
ideas.assumption: Read as custom gridfinity-compatible bins with cutouts profiled to fit a specific set of measured tools, rather than generic grid bins.

ideas.objective: A mobile gacha game where players pull anime-style character cards and use them to cook/produce dishes, progressing through collection and upgrade systems.
ideas.assumption: Read as a mobile game where players collect anime-style character cards (gacha) who cook/produce dishes, with drop-rate gacha mechanics, progression, and touch UI, not a physical cooking simulation.
ideas.drop_reason: Not the kind of thing I want to spend evenings on.

ideas.raw: the ledger stock portfolio tracker app
ideas.objective: A mobile app where a user logs their stock holdings/trades and sees live portfolio value, gains/losses, and performance over time.
ideas.assumption: Read as a mobile app ("Ledger") that tracks a user's stock portfolio with real-time prices, manual trade entry, and persistent accounts, not a blockchain/crypto ledger.

ideas.objective: A wall-mounted shower fixture that blows heated air to dry the user's body after showering, without needing a towel.
ideas.assumption: Read as a wall-mounted inline device that blows heated air over a user standing in the shower, built around a blower and heating element with a waterproof enclosure, not a standalone bathroom appliance outside the shower stall.

ideas.raw: gundam head robot with transformation and tracking so the head moves when a person walks in
ideas.objective: A desktop robot shaped like a Gundam head that physically transforms (moving panels/visor) and pans/tilts to track and face a person who walks into view
ideas.assumption: Read as a desk robot resembling a Gundam head with a transforming mechanism (e.g. opening visor/panels) and pan/tilt tracking that follows a detected person with a camera, not a full humanoid robot

ideas.raw: a bike light that brightens when a car comes up behind
